Overview

Cleveland is a city in OH with a population of 361,607. Rock and Roll Hall of Fame city with cheap housing, lakefront, and a gritty comeback. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Reported crime rates are relatively high.
